headline: F5 Placed in the Leader Tier of the SecureIQLab 2026 Cloud WAAP v5.0 CyberRisk Validation Comparative Report
summary: SEATTLE, August 03, 2026--F5 (NASDAQ: FFIV), the global leader in delivering and securing every app and API, announced that F5 Distributed Cloud Web App and API Protection (WAAP), part of the F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform (ADSP), was placed in the Leader tier of SecureIQLab’s 2026 Cloud WAAP v5.0 CyberRisk Validation Comparative Report. F5 was one of a select few evaluated vendors to earn both the Secure-by-Design and Secure-by-Default certifications.
